title: Floridian Solitaire: A New Variant of Bulgarian Solitaire
summary: Bulgarian solitaire is a well-studied, no-choice, no-loss, one-player game involving stacks of cards. More formally, it is a self-map on the set of partitions of a fixed integer $n.$ As a finite dynamical system, its long-term behavior is well understood. Every trajectory ends in a cycle. The partitions that are in a cycle are parameterized by binary vectors, and the cycles by binary necklaces. Call a partition separated if distinct part sizes differ by at least two.
